claim: Gradient descent on 8x8 unitary operators, given only S5-labelled words of length <= 8 and no relations, learns operators that track S5 exactly on words of length 40 and 160 on 3 of 5 seeds, by building the group's relations into part of the space; the same training restricted to commuting operators stays at the letter-count ceiling.
limits: 2 of 5 seeds fail; readout fitted on labelled long words; one group and width; a lookup table is exact; x86_64 only.
